privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.description: This privacy policy explains how we collect, use, and protect your personal information.

dataCollection.title: Information We Collect
dataCollection.content:
We collect the following information when you use PreWorkout:

• **Account Information**: Email address and name when you sign in with Google.
• **Health Data**: Weight, age, height, gender, and dietary information you voluntarily enter.
• **Usage Data**: Your food diary entries, calorie calculations, and chat conversations with our AI assistant.

dataUsage.title: How We Use Your Information
dataUsage.content:
We use your information to:

• Provide personalized nutrition tracking and recommendations.
• Display your progress and historical data.
• Improve our AI assistant's responses based on your profile.
• Send important service updates (if applicable).

dataStorage.title: Data Storage & Security
dataStorage.content:
Your data is stored securely in Firebase (Google Cloud Platform) with the following protections:

• All data is encrypted in transit using HTTPS.
• Firebase Security Rules ensure only you can access your data.
• We do not sell, share, or rent your personal information to third parties.

thirdParties.title: Third-Party Services
thirdParties.content:
We use the following third-party services:

• **Firebase Authentication**: For secure sign-in (Google).
• **Firebase Realtime Database**: To store your data.
• **xAI Grok**: AI service for chat functionality. Your messages may be processed by this provider according to their privacy policy.

yourRights.title: Your Rights
yourRights.content:
You have the right to:

• **Access**: View all data we have about you.
• **Delete**: Request deletion of your account and all associated data.
• **Export**: Download your data in a portable format.

To exercise these rights, please contact us or use the settings page to delete your account.

contact.title: Contact
contact.content: If you have questions about this privacy policy, please open an issue on our GitHub repository.

terms.title: Terms of Service
terms.description: Please read these terms carefully before using PreWorkout.

acceptance.title: Acceptance of Terms
acceptance.content: By accessing and using PreWorkout, you accept and agree to be bound by these Terms of Service. If you do not agree to these terms, please do not use the application.

healthDisclaimer.title: Health Disclaimer
healthDisclaimer.content:
PreWorkout is a fitness and nutrition tracking tool for informational purposes only. It is NOT a substitute for professional medical advice, diagnosis, or treatment.

• Always consult a healthcare provider before starting any diet or exercise program.
• The calorie calculations and AI recommendations are estimates and may not be accurate for your specific needs.
• If you have any health conditions, please seek professional medical guidance.

userResponsibilities.title: User Responsibilities
userResponsibilities.content:
When using PreWorkout, you agree to:

• Provide accurate information about yourself.
• Use the service for personal, non-commercial purposes only.
• Not attempt to access other users' data or compromise the security of the application.
• Not use the AI chat for any harmful, illegal, or inappropriate purposes.

intellectualProperty.title: Intellectual Property
intellectualProperty.content: PreWorkout is open-source software licensed under the MIT License. You may use, modify, and distribute the code according to the license terms. However, the PreWorkout name and logo remain the property of the project maintainers.

limitation.title: Limitation of Liability
limitation.content:
PreWorkout is provided "as is" without warranties of any kind. We are not liable for:

• Any health issues resulting from following recommendations.
• Loss of data or service interruptions.
• Inaccuracies in calculations or AI responses.

You use the application at your own risk.

changes.title: Changes to Terms
changes.content: We may update these terms from time to time. Continued use of PreWorkout after changes constitutes acceptance of the new terms.
